comment: Quiz every week, and 3 tests + final. Very tough grader, not much opportunity for extra credit. Do not take.

I've heard a lot of bad things about Ms. Clark but I had a great experience with her. Her notes are very clear and she gives you points just for attending class. Homework is also easy to get a hundred on. The tests often came with a formula sheet with everything you needed. I found it very easy to get a high A in this class.
